notes.title: Major Update: New Levels, Excavator, Graphics Overhaul & UI Improvements(v1.5.1)
notes.notes:
[b]We’re thrilled to announce a massive update[/b]! This update brings exciting new content, visual enhancements, and key improvements to make your VR excavating experience better than ever!
[h3]What’s New:[/h3][h3]🚧New Levels[/h3][list]  [*]Explore brand-new levels, each designed with unique challenges and environments to test your excavating skills.[/*]  [*]From rugged mountain terrains to urban construction sites, prepare for more engaging and immersive gameplay![/*][/list][h3]🚜 New Excavator[/h3][list]  [*]Introducing the new excavator! – a powerful and versatile machine built for tackling tough jobs.[/*]  [*]Improved physics and handling make this excavator the most fun to operate yet![/*][/list][h3]🎨 Graphics Overhaul[/h3][list]  [*]We’ve completely revamped the graphics for a more immersive and visually stunning experience.[/*]  [*][b]High-resolution textures[/b] and improved lighting effects bring the game world to life.[/*]  [*]Optimized performance ensures smoother gameplay, even in the most demanding scenes.[/*][/list][h3]🎮 UI Updates[/h3][list]  [*]We’ve redesigned the user interface to make navigation smoother and more intuitive.[/*]  [*]Cleaner menus, improved tooltips, and VR-friendly controls for a seamless in-game experience.[/*]  [*]HUD elements have been refined to give you clear, real-time feedback without cluttering the screen.[/*][/list][h3]Other Improvements:[/h3][list]  [*][b]Performance Optimizations:[/b] Tweaked the game for better FPS in VR across all supported hardware.[/*]  [*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed various bugs reported by the community to improve overall stability.[/*][/list]
Thank you to all our players for your feedback and support! Dive in and try out the new contents.
